title: Roe Deer calls Forest of Saou
description: Roe deer field recording captured in Aubenasson, Drome, France with an ORTF AT4041 setup and MixPre-6 recorder.
changes: The formal deer generator extracts six fixed call windows, converts them to mono 44.1 kHz, reduces stationary field noise, applies a smooth 120-5200 Hz band limit, trims around call activity, and adds short fades. Hurt calls are shortened and the death call is gently lowered without adding synthetic animal vocals.
